selection_reason: Sol had the highest cross-judge fact-safe total (85/88) and no Claude fact loss. It remained disqualified from final selection because material fact losses were confirmed.

material_rulings.reason: The explicit request to leave existing output unchanged became a statement that no change was requested.
Stop a no-match check reverses the requested behavior; the check must stop processing.
Each candidate made the permitted early-stop boundary unconditional. The author obligation is to add a no-match check; the source separately says the check can stop before discovery or publication.
Each candidate turned the permission to report unresolved keys after preserving valid metrics into a mandatory action.
The provider-prefixed-key test lost the requirement to cover the reachable nested-serialization path.
Keeping the nonzero exit conditional on failures is a preservation constraint. Can remain conditional plus an explicit no-change statement preserves that boundary.
Keeping file-symlink behavior unchanged is a preservation constraint, not new author work.

next_change: Separate a new author obligation from its modal implementation boundary, and keep standalone permissions in prose.
